items.name: だい
items.note: Indexing family in 天; extra top stroke distinguishes 天 from 大.

items.name: きがまえ
items.note: 气 surrounds lower メ-like strokes in modern 気.

items.name: とり
items.note: Whole 鳥 radical; also on the right of 鶴.

items.name: め
items.note: Whole eye-derived character; compare its internal divisions with 日.

items.name: みみ
items.note: Ear radical inside 聞; the gate is a separate visible component.

items.name: もんがまえ
items.note: Visible enclosure around the ear in 聞; selected indexing radical of 聞 is 耳.

items.name: ひよみのとり
items.note: Indexes 酒 on the right; 氵 remains a visible left component. Distinguish 酉 from 西.

items.name: いのこ
items.note: Visible historical component under the roof in 家; indexing radical is 宀.

items.name: こころ
items.note: Selected indexing family in assisted 悪; the whole word 悪い is learned with help.

items.name: おと
items.note: Whole sound radical/character; assisted in 音 and 音楽.

items.name: さむらい
items.note: Selected indexing family in assisted 声; distinct from 土 stroke proportions.

items.name: しめすへん
items.note: Side form of 示 in 福, with historical sound component 畐. Distinguish clothing form 衤.

items.name: ひとあし
items.note: Selected indexing family in 先; distinguish the two lower strokes from side form 亻.
